CommunityApplications.Profile:
Sheafly is a self-hosted, Notion-style notes application with cloud synchronization, offline support, and instant full-text search. It runs as a lightweight Docker container with a SQLite database and supports desktop, mobile, and progressive web app experiences.
Features include a block-based editor, nested pages, favorites, search, automatic synchronization across devices, offline editing, and light/dark themes.
For installation instructions, configuration, documentation, and support, visit the GitHub repository.
